dogecoin.text: Just so we're all on the same page: Dogecoin, at it's core, is a chain letter - a publicly shared/viewable file* of numbers (all blockchains are). So... the answer to Che's question(s) "{so} what is dogecoin?" is "A chain letter" (*"file" - there're multiple copies/instances...)

Recap of Musk on SNL:  Che: "so what is Dogecoin?" Musk: "It's a cryptocurrency" Che: "...so what is Dogecoin?" Musk: "It's a cryptocurrency you can trade for money" Che: "oh, so it's a hustle"  Musk "Yeah, it's a hustle". Dogecoin down 24% after that aired
